name: Fjords of Ice (Imperial Origin)
body:
You are from a land where the bitter cold of the frozen rivers serves to empower its champions with powerful frost magic.

Imperial Training: riving axe*

Overloaded Mark: While the mark is active, the target takes additional cold damage equal to 1/2 your emissary level whenever they take cold damage (minimum 1 damage). Additionally, when the mark is expended, the target takes an additional 1d8 cold damage.

Imperial Origin Abilities
Rime Floe (Sp)

At 1st level, you can freeze a target. The target takes 1d6 cold damage plus 1d6 per 3 levels after 1st. A successful Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 your class level + your Charisma modifier) halves this damage.

This ability is usable a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier.

Frozen Nerves (Su)

At 7th level, you can nub your nerves with cold as an immediate action. You gain DR/- equal to 1/3 your emissary level for 1 round. This ability is usable once per day plus an additional use at 13th and 19th levels.

Sleet of War (Su)

At 14th level, as a full round action you can make a melee attack against all enemies within 10 feet of you. In addition to the normal damage, you deal an extra 1d8 cold damage with each hit. This ability is usable once per day plus a second time per day at 19th level.
